Name: Joja Furniture and Decor Pack - THRIVE Home Collection
Author: LeelooStardew

J[font=Arial]oja has expanded to meet your needs with the [/font][color=#3d85c6][font=Arial][size=4][b][i]THRIVE Home Collection™.[/i][/b][/size][/font][/color]

[list]
